name: Collect Assets
description: Every external file of the scene (bitmaps of any renderer, proxies, IES, HDRI, caches, XRefs) with its status and the objects using it, copied into one folder: files with the same name and content are copied once, the scene can be relinked to the copies, a copy of the scene saved for an older 3ds Max and everything zipped.
author: OpenTools contributors
